workflowIdentityPolicy.control: the reviewed workflow commit executing the current dispatch
workflowIdentityPolicy.immutableIdentity: the workflow commit recorded by the public identity asset and GitHub artifact attestations
workflowIdentityPolicy.publication: the package-specific workflow commit, run ID, and attempt recorded by npm provenance

partialPublicationRecovery.baseMutation: skip the base OIDC job when an exact prior base publication is reconciled
partialPublicationRecovery.verification: bind immutable assets to identity_workflow_sha and npm provenance to each package publish workflow/run/attempt; verification-only accepts append-only reviewed control revisions without assuming either package publish revision equals the verifier revision

partialSuccessPolicy: verify exact published packages; never republish; publish the next absent package only after prior package byte/provenance verification
bootstrapPolicy: better-realtime-mcp must exist and have its own trusted publisher before this workflow is dispatched
